ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 IONIQ 5 page gives 10.9 kW home charging for the 84 kWh car; the N uses the same 84 kWh E-GMP pack and the same family of onboard charger (EV Database lists 11 kW for both the N and the 84 kWh Long Range). Hyundai Canada's N page states no AC figure. A search summary of Hyundai USA's N compare-specs page mentions 10.9 kW Level 2, but the page text could not be read, so it is not cited. An Australian listing gives 10.5 kW for its market.
